tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Day is the default; Night follows prefers-color-scheme: dark. Also the theme-color meta per theme.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the Satchel card body, list groups.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, segmented controls, hovered rows. Every text color passes 4.5:1 here.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders, sticker outlines on surfaces. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, balances, the wordmark, the charm outline. 13:1 or better everywhere.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: fiat values, timestamps, helper copy. 5.6:1 or better.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Coral, the logo tile. Primary button fill, selected tab, the Satchel card band. One coral fill per screen, always with on-brand text. Never text.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed primary button; in Day the 1px border on coral buttons (4.1:1 on ground).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the toast behind 'Sent', highlight under a new Satchel.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on coral: 5.7:1. White on coral is 3.0:1 and is not allowed for text.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and text buttons. 5.0:1 on Day ground, 8.3:1 on Night ground.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset.

tokens.name: lemon
tokens.usage: Sticker accent only: pouches, sparkles, the 'New' badge fill (ink text 12.5:1). Never text.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Sticker accent only: illustration fills and backgrounds behind charms.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Sent, Confirmed, Clean history. With an icon and a word.

tokens.name: frozen
tokens.usage: Frozen while listed or in cooldown, and in-progress signing. With an icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: failed signature, unspent signature, Revoke.

tokens.name: chain-btc
tokens.usage: Bitcoin dot and charm fill (illustrations use #f7931a on both themes). Graphics only in Day.

tokens.name: chain-evm
tokens.usage: Ethereum and EVM dot and balance accent.

tokens.name: chain-sol
tokens.usage: Solana dot and balance accent.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Reference only: ships as outlines (satchel-wordmark.svg). Funnel Display ExtraBold, always lowercase.

styles.name: balance-hero
styles.usage: Total on the Satchel card and Wallet tab. 38px below 480px. Tabular figures.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles, Satchel names, landing headlines at 2x.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Give this Satchel to a friend and everything inside goes with it.
styles.usage: Default text; 16px on inputs so iOS Safari does not zoom.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Fiat values, timestamps, helper text. ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, chips, pills. Sentence case.

styles.name: address
styles.usage: Addresses and hashes only, middle-truncated, full value in aria-label, copy button beside it.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, sticker gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone gutter, card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop card padding, gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing, card grid gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on the landing page.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, list groups, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: The Satchel card, sheets, dialogs. Same 22% corner ratio as the logo tile.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, avatars, segmented controls, the charm ring.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: The sticker drop: a hard 4px ink offset under the Satchel card, primary buttons and illustrations. No blur.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, popovers, the wallet-connect modal, sheets.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Ink outline on stickers, the Satchel card and illustrations, matching the logo's charm outline at UI scale.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Larger phones: full type sizes.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Sheets become dialogs; gutter space-6.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Side nav, 2-column card grid.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: 3-column card grid.

tokens.name: container-flow
tokens.usage: Task flows: Send, Sell, Mint, Connect.

tokens.name: container-app
tokens.usage: App shell and grids.
